newsitem.title: USA: Firm raises Aladdin Knowledge stake.
newsitem.headline: Firm raises Aladdin Knowledge stake.

text.p: Mills Value Adviser Inc., a Richmond, Va., investment advisory firm, said Tuesday it raised its stake in Aladdin Knowledge Systems Ltd. to 956,770 common shares, or 9.5 percent of the total, from 778,990 shares, or 7.7 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the firm said it bought the additional shares since September for investment purposes on behalf of its clients, for a total of $1,612,918. Most of the shares were acquired between Nov. 6 and Jan. 7 at prices ranging from $8.99 to $11.13 a share, it said.
